ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is triangle ADC, circle O is inscribed in the triangle, and the points of tangency are respectively B on CA, E on CD, and F on AD. The figure marks AB=19, DF=6. Reasoning: The two tangent segments drawn from the same point to a circle are equal, so from point A there is AF=AB=19; from point D there is DE=DF=6; from point C there is CE=CB. The problem statement gives EC=DE+AF, therefore EC=6+19=25, so CB=25. The three sides of the triangle are AD=AF+FD=19+6=25, DC=DE+EC=6+25=31, AC=AB+BC=19+25=44. The perimeter is 25+31+44=100.

raw_record.question_text: Triangle $ADC$ is circumscribed about $\odot O$. Find the perimeter of $\triangle ADC$ if $EC = DE + AF$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ADC with incircle tangent to CA at B, CD at E, and AD at F. From the image, AB is labeled 19 and DF is labeled 6. From the text, use EC = DE + AF. Because tangent segments from the same external point to a circle are equal, AF = AB = 19, DE = DF = 6, and CE = CB. Then EC = DE + AF = 6 + 19 = 25, so CB = 25. Reconstruct the three sides: AD = AF + FD = 19 + 6 = 25, DC = DE + EC = 6 + 25 = 31, and AC = AB + BC = 19 + 25 = 44. Add the side lengths to get the perimeter 25 + 31 + 44 = 100.

method.method_draft: Use tangent-length variables rather than constructing all three side lengths separately. From the diagram, identify the tangent pairs from each vertex: from A, AB and AF; from D, DE and DF; from C, CB and CE. The image gives AB = 19 and DF = 6, so by equal tangents AF = 19 and DE = 6. The text condition says EC = DE + AF, hence EC = 6 + 19 = 25. Therefore the three vertex tangent lengths are 19 from A, 6 from D, and 25 from C. In a tangential triangle, the semiperimeter equals the sum of one tangent length from each vertex: s = 19 + 6 + 25 = 50. Thus the perimeter is 2s = 100.

推理：同一点向圆作的两条切线段相等。由顶点 A 出发，AB = AF，所以 AF = 19。由顶点 D 出发，DE = DF，所以 DE = 6。根据条件 EC = DE + AF，可得 EC = 6 + 19 = 25。由顶点 C 出发的切线段 CB 与 CE 相等，所以 C 对应的切线长度为 25。三角形的半周长等于三个顶点对应的一条切线段长度之和，即 s = 19 + 6 + 25 = 50。因此周长为 2s = 100。
